summary: One knob that moves up to 8 parameters of other machines at once, each with its own depth, polarity, range and curve. The Value is a parameter, so a pattern can automate it, the agent can set it and a MIDI controller can be bound to it. Use it for one-knob performance moves: a "tension" control that opens a filter, raises a delay's feedback and a drive at once.
use_for: One knob that moves up to 8 parameters of other machines at once, for one-move performance changes.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: The knob: 0 … 100 %, spread over every target by its depth, range and curve
parameters.how: Moves every target at once, from 0 % to 100 % of its own range and depth.
parameters.sound: All the targets sweep together, so one move changes several things in the sound.

parameters.name: Write glide
parameters.description: Time a target takes to cross its whole range: no write moves further than this allows
parameters.how: Limits how fast a target may move: it takes at least this long to cross its whole range.
parameters.sound: A short glide follows the knob closely; a long one lets the targets trail behind it.
